salary_details.pay_scale: No fixed pay: self-earning/entrepreneur basis through service charges, input sales commission, B2B/B2C marketing commission and contingency fee for training

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form (Annexure A) from the office of CAO Budgam or download it from https://budgam.nic.in/.
Fill the form and affix a latest passport size photograph with white background.
Attach self-attested photocopies of date of birth certificate, marks certificates, domicile certificate and character certificate.
Attach the declaration (Annexure B) on notarized affidavit and the affidavit on space attested by a 1st Class Magistrate.
Submit to the office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam in person or through registered post by 18-11-2026, 4:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: CAO Budgam Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 10 CAOB of 2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CAO Budgam notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields (Agriculture, Horticulture, Veterinary Sciences, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture, Agri. Engineering, BHT, BAT) from a government recognized institution; or Graduation in Science (BSc); Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture; B. Tech in Agriculture Engineering, BVSc & AH) from a Government recognized institution Age limit: 21 to 45 years (as of the last date of submission) Other conditions: Domicile Certificate to be attached with the application Desirable: Post-graduation (science/agri & allied) Diploma/Certification course in computers of 3 or more months duration from a government recognised institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: No fixed pay: earnings from service charges at rates notified by Mission Director HADP, commission on input sales, B2B/B2C marketing commission and contingency fee for training. Engagement initially for 2 years, with possibility of annual extensions subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of scheme Refundable security of Rs 10,000 as Fixed Deposit Receipt from a scheduled commercial bank Agreement may be terminated by either party with 3-month prior notice Undertaking to stay minimum two years; security of INR 10,000 forfeited on exit before two years No right to claim regular appointment under the Scheme Works on franchise-franchisee basis under supervision of a Designated APD Officer

content_sections.heading: How Will CAO Budgam Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Point-based system (100 points) Document verification Publication of list of selected candidates Agreement signing Domicile of Local Panchayat: 25 points Female candidates: 05 points Highest-scoring eligible candidates considered; shortlisted candidates undergo document verification

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of birth certificate (Matriculation certificate) Marks certificate of all qualifying examinations Domicile Certificate Character certificate issued by the competent authority Declaration on notarized affidavit (Annexure B) Affidavit attested by 1st Class Magistrate on availability of space

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CAO Budgam Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form (Annexure A) from the office of CAO Budgam or download it from https://budgam.nic.in/. Fill the form and affix a latest passport size photograph with white background. Attach self-attested photocopies of date of birth certificate, marks certificates, domicile certificate and character certificate. Attach the declaration (Annexure B) on notarized affidavit and the affidavit on space attested by a 1st Class Magistrate. Submit to the office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam in person or through registered post by 18-11-2026, 4:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected without further notice Postal delay is not the responsibility of the APD/advertising authority Original documents must be presented during verification List of selected candidates will be published on the websites of the District and the Agriculture Production Department APD reserves the right to change or add any condition at the time of signing the agreement

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CAO Budgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CAO Budgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Krishi Udyami (KU) (Agricultural Entrepreneur).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CAO Budgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure A of this notice; also from office of CAO Budgam or https://budgam.nic.in/) and send it to Office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years (as of the last date of submission).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No fixed pay: self-earning/entrepreneur basis through service charges, input sales commission, B2B/B2C marketing commission and contingency fee for training.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields or Graduation in Science (BSc), Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc/BVSc); additional preference for post-graduation (science/agri & allied) and computer diplomas/certifications.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Domicile Certificate to be attached with the application.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Point-based system (100 points). Document verification. Publication of list of selected candidates. Agreement signing.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement initially for 2 years, with possibility of annual extensions subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of scheme. Refundable security of Rs 10,000 as Fixed Deposit Receipt from a scheduled commercial bank. Agreement may be terminated by either party with 3-month prior notice.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by CAO Budgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KKG Dharambugh, B.K.PORA block, Budgam, KKG Nagbal, PAKHERPORA block, Budgam.
